register.description: Register to access your AutoService Formula 1 account.

login.title: Log In to Your Account
login.description: Log in to your AutoService Formula 1 account.

forgot-pwd.title: Forgot password?
forgot-pwd.description: Enter the email address associated with your AutoService Formula 1 account and we'll send you a password reset link.
forgot-pwd.email-invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
forgot-pwd.error: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
forgot-pwd.success-description: If an account with this email address exists, we have sent you a password reset link.

reset-pwd.title: Reset password
reset-pwd.description: Enter a new password for your AutoService Formula 1 account.
reset-pwd.password-min: Password must be at least 12 characters long.
reset-pwd.password-lowercase: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter.
reset-pwd.password-uppercase: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter.
reset-pwd.password-number: Password must contain at least one number.
reset-pwd.password-special: Password must contain at least one special character.
reset-pwd.invalid-token: The password reset link is invalid or incomplete.
reset-pwd.error: The password reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
reset-pwd.success-description: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in with your new password.
